thread:
Anne: quick heads up — deploy-bot preflight for release/2026-03-22 flagged a provider drift in the IAM module. holding the full apply.

deploy-bot: PRE-FLIGHT: terraform plan error in modules/iam
Modules: iam (module.accounts)
Diff: would recreate 2 google_service_account, modify 1 google_project_iam_binding
Note: provider.hashicorp/google reported v4.3.0 installed vs pinned ~>4.2.1

Sam: could we do a selective apply for network changes and hold IAM? prefer not to block the whole cutover.

Marta: IAM change is security-sensitive and in release notes. need PM + sec sign-off before landing. @lisa-pm can you advise?

Lisa-pm: pause IAM. do not ship role/service-account changes without sec clearance. add rollback steps to the release notes and mark the change as gated.

Ryan-oncall: tagging @sec-oncall. options: A) pin provider in release branch and apply non-iam modules. B) canary apply IAM to tenant-1 only. both need plan+approval.

Kai: If we go with pinning, add the constraint to versions.tf and run providers lock. example:
```
terraform {
  required_providers {
    google = {
      source = "hashicorp/google"
      version = "~> 4.2.1"
    }
  }
}
```
Then `terraform init -upgrade=false` and re-run plan.

Sam: will open a PR to pin and include a targeted apply command for non-iam modules: `terraform apply -target=module.network -target=module.ipam -var=release=2026-03-22`

Marta: also include explicit rollback snippet in notes: how to revert IAM changes and state-migration steps if we accidentally applied.

Anne: putting a 30m hold on deploy-bot approvals until security reviews. leaving canary window open. :eyes:

deploy-bot: HOLD placed on release/2026-03-22 by Anne. Approval required from Lisa-pm, sec-oncall, Ryan-oncall. Override allowed with audited command.

Sam: PR created: https://git.redwood/infracode/pulls/333 — pin + plan output attached.

Lisa-pm: coordinating with sec. ETA ~15–25m. will reply here when cleared.

sec-oncall: reviewing the IAM diff now. initial thought: looks like SA recreation could break token minting. need an integration test run in staging canary before prod apply.

Ryan-oncall: if sec requests canary, I can run tenant-1 canary tonight and monitor logs/traces. keep rollback playbook ready (state rm & reimport example).

Kai: don't forget to update deploy-bot release notes metadata with the gated flag and links to the PR and rollback snippet.

Marta: added a "Rollback steps" section to release notes draft and linked the runbook.

Anne: thanks. I'll keep the hold and ping when approvals complete. :thumbsup:
